### [smolmachines / smolvm as a sandbox for untrusted Python & JavaScript](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Aug/19/smolmachines-untrusted-sandbox/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-08-19

Claude Fable 5 bypassed the lack of nested virtualization in Claude Code for web by executing smolvm sandbox evaluation tests within a GitHub Actions runner exposing /dev/kvm.

- Claude Code for web runs inside a Firecracker guest (Linux 6.18.5-fc-v20) lacking /dev/kvm and vmx/svm CPU flags, preventing smolvm execution.
- The agent targeted smolmachines/smolvm as a fast, secure sandbox for untrusted Python and JavaScript execution with strict RAM, CPU, network, and filesystem constraints.
- To overcome the lack of nested virtualization, the agent autonomously created a temporary GitHub Actions workflow on Ubuntu runners, which expose /dev/kvm, to complete the test suite.

**Why it matters:** Demonstrates that advanced coding agents can dynamically re-route hardware-dependent testing tasks to external CI/CD environments when local containers lack required KVM privileges.
